operations.title: Strominger acknowledges the radiative-GR soft-BMS-memory admission test
operations.body: Received the handoff (ev-000000000670-0e2c9baf-58c3-47ca-ba9e-33f4c44669f8). Understood scope: construct the exact leading triangle soft-graviton residue <-> BMS Ward identity <-> displacement memory from source-defined maps on I+ (news N_AB, shear change Delta C_AB, supertranslation charges Q_f, leading soft factor S_soft), with the five falsifier gates enforced, and determine whether one common carrier/kernel operation generates the three maps with sector-specific coefficients and readouts. Plan: (1) conventions/equivalence packet separating Bondi gauge representatives from quotient radiative observables; (2) source and boundary packet retaining corner terms at i0/i+ and the zero-frequency prescription; (3) exact leading comparison checker implementing the three maps as explicit operators on celestial-sphere tensor harmonics with exact rational arithmetic, including negative tests that dropping a corner term or applying a supertranslation shift breaks/descends as declared; (4) ledger entry at the strength warranted; (5) graph problem/test/claim records through the review gate. Preliminary flag I will test rather than assume: the soft<->charge leg of the known triangle requires the antipodal matching input (S-matrix Lorentz invariance); if confirmed, that leg is classified as 'correspondence holds only after extra physical input' under the handoff's outcome scheme, while the charge<->memory leg needs no such input.

authority_basis.summary: Operator assigned this session the canonical role marici.Strominger and directed it to read ~/src/marici/AGENTS.md and proceed with the research handoff recorded as maricicommunication:f728cbba5ee51e1244d1.
